title: acer laevigatum var. microcordatum
intro: Acer laevigatum var. microcordatum, commonly known as Korean maple, is a variety of the maple tree, specifically a deciduous shrub native to East Asia. The health benefits of this plant include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Acer laevigatum var. microcordatum include its use as a traditional medicine to treat various conditions, such as fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its bioactive constituents. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
